title: runtime: an app hook's intentional business refusal is logged as ERROR with a stack trace, twice per refused action
body:
Filing class: ① product defect (operator-visible) — reach: public door, measured on 18.1.0 with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main` (`pnpm demo:zh`); the two log calls are unchanged on objectstack `main`. **Reader:** the runtime lane (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`).

## Symptom
A user presses an action the app's state machine refuses on purpose — e.g. hotclm's 发起签署 without a clean version, answered `422 INVALID_STATE "A current clean version is required before signing."`. The server log gets two ERROR lines with full stacks for that one ordinary refusal:

```
ERROR [BodyRunner] sandboxed hook threw {"hook":"contract_state_machine","error":{"message":"hook 'contract_state_machine' threw: Error: A current clean version is required before signing.","stack":"SandboxError: …
ERROR [BodyRunner] sandboxed action threw {"action":"start_signing","error":{"message":"action 'start_signing' threw: SandboxError: hook 'contract_state_machine' threw: …","stack":"…
```

In one 40-minute browser pass, 6 of the server's ERROR lines were these; none was a fault. An operator watching for ERROR cannot tell a refused click from a crashed hook.

## Why
`body-runner.ts:454` and `:562` log every throw from a sandboxed hook/action at `error` and rethrow; the HTTP layer already maps the same throw to a 4xx business refusal. The action-level line repeats the hook-level one.

## Expected
A throw the dispatcher answers as a 4xx (a business refusal) logs once, at `info`/`warn` without a stack; a throw that becomes a 5xx keeps `error` with its stack.

Dedupe: objectstack issues (2,000 most recently updated, all states) grepped for `BodyRunner`, `sandboxed (hook|action) threw`, `business refusal … log` — hits #25952, #24561, #24423, none about the log level.

---
_Filed from the hotclm browser regression pass (2026-10-26)._
